sn48.44:1.2: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Savatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbakoṭṭhake || || 2.
sn48.44:1.3: Tatra kho Bhagavā āyasmantam Sāriputtam āmantesi || || 3.
sn48.44:1.5: Saddhindriyam bhāvitaṃ bahulīkatam amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ || la || paññindriyam bhāvitam bahulīkatam amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanam amatapariyosānanti || || 4.
sn48.44:2.1: Na khvāham ettha bhante Bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi
sn48.44:2.2: saddhindriyam ||la || paññindriyam bhāvitaṃ bahulīkatam amatogadham hoti || amataparāyanam amatapariyosānaṃ || ||
sn48.44:2.3: Yesaṃ hi tam bhante aññātam assa adiṭṭham aviditam asacchikatam aphusitam paññaya te tattha paresam saddhāya gaccheyyuṃ ||
